answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 7262 Country: India Title: I would like to know that one of friend's sister is working in Life Insurance Company as a Sales Manager. Would like to know whether this job is Halal or Haram for her ? Appreciate the swift response. Question: Assalaamu Alaikum, I would like to know that one of friend's sister is working in Life Insurance Company as a Sales Manager. Would like to know whether this job is Halal or Haram for her ? Appreciate the swift response. Jazakallah Answer ID: 7262 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1417/1333=D/1429) The dealings in insurance company are based on interest and gambling; therefore it is unlawful to work there. If she fears any trouble in giving up the job immediately, then she should look for a lawful job and leave this one when finds a suitable one. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
